questions.stem_latex:
In Cherry Harbour, the height of the water above sea level, $h$ (in metres), is modelled by the function $h = 6.5 - 2\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}t\right)$ where $t$ is the number of hours after midnight on Saturday.

Boats can safely enter the Harbour when the water is at least 7 metres above sea level.

parts.label: a
parts.latex: By considering the transformation of $h = \cos t$, draw a graph showing the height of the water in the harbour for the 24 hours commencing at midnight on Saturday.

parts.label: b
parts.latex: Show that the earliest time for a boat to enter Cherry Harbour on Sunday is 6.58am.

parts.label: c
parts.latex: How long can boats enter Cherry Harbour before the water is too shallow again? Give your answer to the nearest minute.

solutions.latex: $\log_x 5 = \dfrac{\log_5 5}{\log_5 x} = \dfrac{1}{\log_5 x}$ as $\log_5 5 = 1$ (change of base to base 5).
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: must use the change of base formula

solutions.latex:
$\log_5 x = 4\cdot\dfrac{1}{\log_5 x}$ (from (a))

$(\log_5 x)^2 = 4$

$\log_5 x = \pm 2$

$\log_5 x = 2$ gives $x = 5^2 = 25$, or $\log_5 x = -2$ gives $x = 5^{-2} = \dfrac{1}{25}$.
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: using part (a); 2: two solutions with working

solutions.latex:
$m_{\text{tangent}} = -3e$, so $m_{\text{normal}} = \dfrac{1}{3e}$. At $x=-1$, $y = 3e^{-(-1)} = 3e$.

Equation of the normal: $y - 3e = \dfrac{1}{3e}(x+1)$, i.e. $3e(y - 3e) = x + 1$, $x - 3ey + 9e^2 - 1 = 0$ (the guidelines write $(x-1)$ in the first line, an apparent slip).
solutions.marks_breakdown: 2: some version of the correct equation with working; 1: finding the $y$ value
2: solving the equation with working; 1: eliminating the incorrect solution

solutions.latex: $L(t=0) = 6 - 4e^{-k(0)} = 6 - 4\times 1 = 2$. The length of the whale at birth is 2 m.

solutions.marks_breakdown: 2: value of $k$ with correct working; 1: some progress

solutions.latex: $L = 6 - 4e^{-kt}$. As $t \to \infty$, $e^{-kt} \to 0$, so $L \to 6 - 4\times 0 = 6$. The length of a whale from this species cannot exceed 6 metres.

solutions.latex:
$3\sin\theta - \dfrac{2}{\sin\theta} = 5$

$3\sin^2\theta - 2 - 5\sin\theta = 0$

$(3\sin\theta + 1)(\sin\theta - 2) = 0$

$\sin\theta = -\dfrac{1}{3}$ or $\sin\theta = 2$. $\sin\theta = 2$ has no solutions as $-1 \le \sin\theta \le 1$.

Reference angle $0.340$; $\sin$ is negative in the 3rd and 4th quadrants: $\theta = \pi + 0.340 = 3.48$ or $\theta = 2\pi - 0.340 = 5.94$.

$\theta = 3.48$ radians, $5.94$ radians.
solutions.marks_breakdown: 2: solving the equation with full working; 1: $\sin\theta = 2$ has no solution
2: showing the necessary steps to prove the result; 1: making some progress

solutions.latex:
$7 = 6.5 - 2\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}t\right)$

$2\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}t\right) = -0.5$

$\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}t\right) = -0.25$

Reference angle $1.318$. $\dfrac{\pi}{12}t = \pi - 1.318$ (or $\pi + 1.318$).

$t = \dfrac{\pi - 1.318}{\pi/12} = 6.9656 = 6\text{ h }58\text{ m}$.

The earliest time for a boat to enter Cherry Harbour is 6.58 am.
solutions.marks_breakdown: 2: correct answer with full working; 1: making some progress

solutions.latex:
Boats can enter when $\pi - 1.318 \le \dfrac{\pi}{12}t \le \pi + 1.318$, so $\dfrac{(\pi - 1.318)\,12}{\pi} \le t \le \dfrac{(\pi + 1.318)\,12}{\pi}$, i.e. 6.58 am $\le t \le$ 5.02 pm.

Boats can enter Cherry Harbour for 10 h 4 m, between 6.58 am and 5.02 pm.
